mapper.sql: payment_id, member_id, payment_key, order_id, amount, status, created_at, canceled_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment (member_id, payment_key, order_id, amount, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{paymentKey}, #{orderId}, #{amount}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM payment WHERE payment_key = #{paymentKey}
SELECT FROM payment WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE payment SET status = 'CHARGED' WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE payment SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE payment SET status = 'CANCELING', canceled_at = NOW() WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'CHARGED'
UPDATE payment SET status = 'CANCELED' WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'CANCELING'
UPDATE payment SET status = 'CHARGED', canceled_at = NULL WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId} AND status = 'CANCELING'
mapper.select: SELECT FROM payment WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'CANCELING') AND updated_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{staleMinutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY payment_id LIMIT 100
